stories.title: Claude brings spreadsheets and whiteboards into chat
stories.summary: Claude Sheets and Whiteboards enter beta, while Claude Data becomes generally available. Teams can edit spreadsheets, organize discussions and share data inside Claude.
stories.insight: Try moving an event retrospective from a shared board into an action tracker. The test is whether teammates can take over the same artifact.

stories.title: Adobe Firefly puts more design work on one canvas
stories.summary: Firefly Design enters beta with vector, raster, motion, 3D and print tools in one workspace. Adobe also showed how its Creative Agent can coordinate tools.
stories.insight: A shared canvas could make it easier to adapt a campaign's visual identity across social and print.

stories.title: MiniMax releases H3-Image weights
stories.summary: The model generates and edits images with up to 16 references. MiniMax showed how the same product could appear across several campaign settings.
stories.insight: A practical test is whether packaging text, logos and product shape stay consistent across ad variations.

stories.title: ChatGPT Business usage extends to outside tools
stories.summary: OpenAI says supported tools include Notion, v0 and Amp. Workspace admins can enable access and set usage limits.
stories.insight: Teams can test whether a shared plan makes usage easier to manage across the tools they already use.

stories.title: Gemini Live comes to Apple CarPlay
stories.summary: Google is rolling out hands-free Gemini conversations on CarPlay. Users can resume a conversation from their phone or ask for calendar and email catch-ups.
stories.insight: Continuing the same conversation across devices gives voice assistants a more natural place in daily routines.

stories.title: Google opens Gemini 4 Carbon to developers and enterprises
stories.summary: Google is making Carbon available through its API and previewing coordinated agents in Antigravity, where Carbon can plan or review work handled in parallel.
stories.insight: For real work with multiple steps, compare the time saved with the number of fixes still needed from a person.

stories.title: Mistral puts live transcription to work on a conference stage
stories.summary: Mistral used Voxtral to transcribe the main stage at AI Engineer Paris, giving it speaker names and technical terms from the agenda to improve recognition.
stories.insight: A glossary of names and technical terms can make live captions and event notes easier to use.

stories.title: Expo brings cross-platform UI testing to coding agents
stories.summary: Expo's Exact project lets agents drive and inspect web, macOS and iOS interfaces using a common set of operations and screenshots.
stories.insight: A team can reuse the same user journey to check a prototype on desktop and mobile.

stories.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 sorts parts on a Mercedes-Benz production line
stories.summary: Google DeepMind, Apptronik and Mercedes-Benz tested whether a humanoid robot could arrange car parts into trays in assembly order.
stories.insight: The useful next measure is how often a person needs to step in when parts or shifts change.

stories.title: DeepMind uses AI to verify key properties of Signal's encryption code
stories.summary: AlphaProof Code produced machine-checkable proofs for specific security properties of Signal's core cryptographic implementation, under specifications reviewed by researchers.
stories.insight: Independent tools can check the proof alongside the result, a useful standard for AI-assisted verification.
